messages:
emily: Quick sync — we're rolling out the v2 API and need the migration guide + SDK snippets updated. Planning to deprecate a few v1 examples. Can we coordinate PR owners? @raj for SDK snippets?

raj: Got it. What's the rollout window and scope?

emily: Targeting week of Apr 12. Scope: plain HTTP examples, JS/TS SDK, Python SDK, a short migration checklist listing renamed params, and an optional compatibility-wrapper snippet for teams who can't upgrade immediately. Also a small deprecation banner.

michael: I can take the Python snippets. Quick q: for the old `model` param behavior do we show direct mapping to new model names or recommend using the model alias mapping?

emily: Show both. Small table + a mapping object example. Keep the main examples with the recommended v2 names, and include a tiny block named "Compatibility: mapping from v1 -> v2".

sara: I'll do the JS/TS. Plan: short before/after diff, and a one-file compatibility wrapper export folks can drop in. Also pinging marketing for the banner wording.

raj: I'll review the API surface in the SDK README; can add a `withFallback()` helper example so apps can automatically route to a compatible model variant on errors.

docs-bot: Reminder: add label `migration-v1-to-v2` and attach changelog link https://redwood.dev/changelog/v2. Use docs/migration-template.md for structure.

emily: Important: call out tokenization differences (small changes in token counts) and note potential quantization/regression impacts on exact logits. Keep those notes brief so users know to re-run critical evals.

michael: PR opened for Python snippets: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4123 — includes usage examples + a tiny unit test. CI shows lint error currently.

ci-bot: Lint error in pr #4123: docs/python/snippets.md line 24: trailing whitespace.

sara: I'll open the TS PR tomorrow. Need the exact deprecation banner wording before I add it to the top of the migration page.

emily: Draft banner suggestion: "Deprecation notice: legacy v1 model endpoints will be removed on 2026-06-01. Migrate to v2 — follow this guide." Keep the date bold in the banner.

raj: +1 on the banner. @sara can you include the `client.withFallback()` snippet in the example section? Something like: `client.withFallback({primary:'text-latest', fallback:'gptx-compat'})`

sara: Yep. Quick compatibility wrapper sketch: 
```js
// TS compatibility wrapper
export function createCompatClient(oldConfig) {
  const c = new RedwoodV2Client(oldConfig);
  return {
    generate: (req) => c.responses.create(transform(req)),
    // preserve legacy field names here
  }
}
```

emily: That's exactly what I had in mind. Also add a tiny note showing a model-swap fallback pattern: request preferred model, on 503/overquota call a `retryWith({model:"gptx-compat"})`.

michael: Added fallback example and test to my PR; will re-run lint.

emily: Who wants ownership of the external comms (customer emails + changelog entry)?

raj: I'll own external comms + support Q&A doc with a few known gotchas.

sara: I'll coordinate with marketing for the banner and social comms.

emily: Great. I'll create a single tracking checklist in the main PR description linking everyone's PRs and the changelog. After that we'll flip the deprecation banner two weeks before date. :thumbsup:

michael: CI fixed, merging after one more review.

ci-bot: All checks passed for pr #4123.

emily: Thanks all — please add any small migration testcases (prompt + expected tokens) into `examples/migrations/` in the docs repo. I'll post the final banner text in this thread when ready.

raj: Added note to support doc about tokenization variance and a quick repro snippet.

emily: Closing loop: will open the deprecation banner PR by EOD and tag each of you as reviewers. Thanks!
